title: Cessna 172 訓練機系統
subcategoryTitle: 民航機與世界航空案例
subcategoryTitleEn: Civil aircraft and world aviation cases
summary: 以Cessna 172訓練機作可辨識外形的工程案例，學習四力相關量、簡單翼結構和儀表量測，不教授飛行操縱或真機檢修。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use the recognizable Cessna 172 as an engineering case for force-related quantities, simple wing structures and instrument measurements, without flight instruction or aircraft servicing. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 空速與差壓觀察：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Airspeed and differential-pressure observation: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 空速與差壓觀察 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Airspeed and differential-pressure observation and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 動壓是單位體積動能，速度平方使高速下的小速度誤差放大；靜壓與總壓不能互換。
steps.instructionEn: Dynamic pressure is kinetic energy per volume; its square-speed dependence amplifies speed errors, and static and total pressure are not interchangeable.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Cessna 172 訓練機系統實際性能或製程：密度ρ=1.20 kg/m³，模型速度V=30 m/s。式 q=ρV²/2，基準結果 540 Pa。適用條件：低馬赫、定密度教學流；可壓縮流需修正。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Cessna 172 training-aircraft systems: Density rho=1.20 kg/m³ and model speed V=30 m/s. Formula q=ρV²/2 gives 540 Pa. Conditions: Low-Mach constant-density teaching flow; compressible flow needs correction.
steps.failure: 壓管漏氣或把靜壓當動壓會造成速度偏差，先查管路再改模型係數。
steps.failureEn: Leaking pressure lines or treating static pressure as dynamic pressure biases speed; check plumbing before changing model coefficients.
steps.check: 比較差壓計零點、總壓孔與靜壓孔位置，再將每秒資料配對取樣。
steps.checkEn: Compare transducer zero and total/static port positions, then pair time-stamped samples.

knowledge.text: 動壓是單位體積動能，速度平方使高速下的小速度誤差放大；靜壓與總壓不能互換。

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再僅把V改成36 m/s；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 540 改為 777.6 Pa。在算式區重算並記下對「空速與差壓觀察」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only V to 36 m/s, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 540 to 777.6 Pa. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Airspeed and differential-pressure observation, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 動壓是單位體積動能，速度平方使高速下的小速度誤差放大；靜壓與總壓不能互換。

optionsEn: Dynamic pressure is kinetic energy per volume; its square-speed dependence amplifies speed errors, and static and total pressure are not interchangeable.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Doubling speed only doubles dynamic pressure.
quiz.explanation: 動壓是單位體積動能，速度平方使高速下的小速度誤差放大；靜壓與總壓不能互換。 比較差壓計零點、總壓孔與靜壓孔位置，再將每秒資料配對取樣。
quiz.explanationEn: Dynamic pressure is kinetic energy per volume; its square-speed dependence amplifies speed errors, and static and total pressure are not interchangeable. Compare transducer zero and total/static port positions, then pair time-stamped samples.

steps.title: 機翼升力基本帳：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Basic wing-lift ledger: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 機翼升力基本帳 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Basic wing-lift ledger and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 升力由動壓、參考翼面積與升力係數相乘；係數含翼型、迎角、雷諾數及壓縮性條件。
steps.instructionEn: Lift multiplies dynamic pressure, reference wing area and lift coefficient; the coefficient depends on section, incidence, Reynolds number and compressibility.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Cessna 172 訓練機系統實際性能或製程：ρ=1.2 kg/m³，V=30 m/s，S=2 m²，CL=0.6。式 L=ρV²SCL/2，基準結果 648 N。適用條件：低速固定CL模型，未描述失速或三維分離。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Cessna 172 training-aircraft systems: rho=1.2 kg/m³, V=30 m/s, S=2 m² and CL=0.6. Formula L=ρV²SCL/2 gives 648 N. Conditions: Low-speed fixed-CL model, excluding stall and three-dimensional separation.
steps.failure: 使用濕面積取代參考翼面積會使係數不可比；分離後不能保持線性CL。
steps.failureEn: Using wetted area instead of reference wing area breaks coefficient comparisons; CL cannot remain linear after separation.
steps.check: 扣除支架皮重，以同一面積正規化力天平讀值，分別記錄迎角上掃與下掃。
steps.checkEn: Subtract support tare, normalize balance forces with one area definition, and record increasing and decreasing incidence separately.
